title: Schooner Wonder
specs: Authentic seamanship instruction including setting sails, tying knots, reading a compass, and decision-making at sea
Wildlife observation and marine science projects such as ocean water sampling and surface net towing
No sailing experience required; designed for first-time sailors

options.name: Cape Cod Voyage
options.detail: Sail between New York City and Boston through Buzzard’s Bay, around Cape Cod, with whale watching and port stops on Martha’s Vineyard and Block Island.

options.name: Key West Voyage
options.detail: Sail amongst mangrove islands of the Key West National Wildlife Refuge, snorkel on reefs, and swim in warm tropical waters.

options.name: Long Distance Voyage
options.detail: Voyage between Key West and New England, including open ocean sailing and navigating channels through Carolina marshes.

services.name: Sail Handling
services.desc: Setting and striking sails, tacking and gybing, furling and trimming…these will start as foreign concepts and quickly become second nature. Sail handling is almost never done alone; you rely on your shipmates to help accomplish a shared goal. Working together to complete a sail evolution will start off a bit clunky,

blurb: Guests participate fully in ship life including setting sails, conducting science deployments, taking the helm, standing watch at night, and learning to use a sextant. Voyages include sailing between New York City and Boston, among mangrove islands in Key West, and long distance voyages between Key West and New England. No sailing experience is required; voyages are designed for first-time sailors.
